definitions.explanation: Communicating something without stating it directly. The message is conveyed through hints, implications, or indirect means rather than explicit words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暗|あん}に⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暗|あん}に⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ものだった。
examples.english: That remark was an implicit call for resignation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暗|あん}に⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: I realized my boss was implicitly telling me to put in more effort.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal adverb derived from {暗|あん} (dark, hidden). Used in written and semi-formal contexts. Modifies verbs of communication or expression: {暗|あん}に⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ (to imply), {暗|あん}に⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ (to convey indirectly), {暗|あん}に⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to implicitly demand).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗|あん}に⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to imply, to suggest indirectly
- {暗|あん}に⟦{批判|ひはん}する→批判する：21993_hihansuru⟧: to criticize implicitly
- {暗|あん}に⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to tacitly acknowledge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦それとなく→それとなく：08510_soretonaku⟧: indirectly, casually (softer, more conversational)
- ⟦{暗黙|あんもく}→暗黙：12876_anmoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: tacit, unspoken (adjective)
- ⟦{遠回|とおまわ}し→遠回し：08054_toomawashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in a roundabout way
